baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَعَوْتُهُمْ at word 3 is qualified by جِهَارًا at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb supplies speech that tries to draw the plural addressees near, while the manner noun externalizes that speech as openly voiced. The construction therefore presents an overt invitation rather than an inward wish or indirect signal.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech literally draws an addressee near and supplies the invitation's directional action.
Open voicing and raised sound literally externalize the call and supply its overt mode.

changed_reading.after: Noah issued an overt vocal invitation meant to draw them toward a response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adverbial جِهَارًا at word 4 can qualify how دَعَوْتُهُمْ becomes perceptible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call is not only audible; it is brought out where it can be plainly perceived. جهر contributes public manifestation, shifting attention from decibel level to exposure and inspectability.

activation_trace.role: The speech-call supplies the communicative act that is being made perceptible.
Plain visible manifestation literally brings something before the eye and makes publicity the call's functional mode.

changed_reading.after: He made the invitation publicly perceptible and inspectable, with publicity rather than volume alone foregrounded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural object in دَعَوْتُهُمْ and the collective branch of جِهَارًا support a public social scene.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call draws people by speech while جهر supplies the image of an assembled group. The verse can stage an address before or to a collective, not merely the same message spoken more loudly to isolated hearers.

activation_trace.role: The calling branch supplies speech directed toward drawing the plural audience near.
The assembled-group image gives the overt call a collective venue and social audience.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an unmarked address to several people.
changed_reading.after: The verse evokes a deliberately collective public address.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated attempts to draw the people near instead produce flight and deliberate covering. After those blocked channels, ثُمَّ plus جِهَارًا reads as a modality change: the invitation is moved into shared public exposure where private withdrawal cannot keep it wholly concealed.

activation_trace.role: The focus call still literally tries to draw the addressees near and anchors the revised tactic.
Plain manifestation supplies the counter-move of bringing the invitation into public perceptibility.
The earlier speech-call establishes that the public phase follows an already active effort to draw them near.
Literal flight reverses the call's drawing motion and supplies the resistance that prompts escalation.
A cover rising over and concealing something supplies deliberate occlusion as the obstacle to public manifestation.
Clothing as a covering gives the preceding concealment a concrete material layer.

structural_cues: 71:5-8 repeats the call across night/day, flight, sensory blocking, and then ثُمَّ plus جِهَارًا.
The branchless ص ب ع cue in 71:7 places fingers in ears, making blocked reception explicit without an invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling, flight, layered covering, and sequential ثُمَّ; I infer that resistance prompts a shift into publicly exposed delivery. A live alternative is simple chronological intensification with no causal response to concealment.

changed_reading.before: جِهَارًا merely raises the volume of the same attempt.
changed_reading.after: جِهَارًا is an anti-occlusion escalation that places the invitation in shared public view after hearers flee and cover themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next step pairs explicit announcement with inward secrecy. That polarity makes the focus's open call one pass in a deliberate channel-switching strategy, covering public and private access rather than fixing on one permanent preaching style.

activation_trace.role: The invitation by speech remains the stable action while its delivery channel changes.
Open voicing supplies the overt pole of the channel sequence.
Making something appear and proclaiming it publicly reinforces the overt delivery pole.
Concealing something inwardly supplies the opposite private pole and turns publicity into one complementary mode.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ recurs in 71:8 and 71:9, and 71:9 coordinates أَعْلَنتُ with أَسْرَرْتُ in one methodological sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered open call followed by announced and secret delivery; I infer a strategy designed to cover every communicative channel. A live alternative is that جهر and إعلان simply accumulate as near-synonymous intensifiers before a separate secret appeal.

changed_reading.before: The open call is Noah's chosen standing mode.
changed_reading.after: The open call is one overt pass within a comprehensive public/private campaign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material branch images align around priming, clearing, and continued outflow: the focus call can be imagined as the remnant that draws more yield, while its openness clears a source; the later promise sends a successive abundant flow, extends provision, and reaches rivers. The public invitation thus becomes a channel-opening act rather than information alone.

activation_trace.role: The milk remnant that draws further milk supplies the literal primer image and models the invitation as eliciting continuation.
Clearing a well until its water appears supplies a literal unblocking image for the call's public disclosure.
Successive milk and flow gives the promised sending a continuing-yield image that answers the focus primer.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the release and volume of the promised rain.
Connected increase that extends another thing turns the flow into sustained material support.
A river cutting the earth with running water gives the activated flow a durable channel and destination.

structural_cues: After the delivery-method sequence in 71:8-9, 71:10-12 moves from seeking forgiveness to rain, connected increase, gardens, and rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies primer, well-clearing, successive-yield, outflow, extension, and river images; I infer a cross-material arrow from invitation to opened response and benefit flow. A live alternative is that these are only promised contents of repentance and do not characterize the act of calling.

changed_reading.before: The public utterance only transmits a proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the public invitation primes and clears a channel through which response and promised abundance can continue to flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventories permit both a claim of affiliation and an assembled public. Later, the same people follow a wealth-backed authority and defend their worshipped gods. The open call can therefore function as a public counter-claim over rightful belonging and authority, not only an attempt to be heard.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation supplies the social-legal force of a competing public summons.
The assembled-group image supplies the public arena in which rival affiliations are contested.
A community of people identifies the call's target as a social body rather than disconnected individuals.
Loyal following and succession supplies the rival allegiance that the public call must contest.
Possessing and multiplying wealth supplies the social authority around which the rival following coheres.
Worship and the worshipped object identify the allegiance's ultimate religious claim.

structural_cues: The plural object in 71:8 addresses a collective, while 71:21-23 later identifies that collective's leaders, following, and defended gods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies community, affiliation-claim, assembly, loyal following, wealth, and worship; I infer that publicity turns the invitation into a contest over communal allegiance. A live alternative is that these later relations explain rejection without changing the semantic force of جِهَارًا.

changed_reading.before: Noah makes his religious message audible to the group.
changed_reading.after: Noah publicly advances a rival claim on the community's allegiance against wealth-backed leadership and inherited worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is characterized as meaning made clear, and the later appeal asks the audience to see a luminous created order. Against that sequence, the focus's plain manifestation can exceed vocal publicity: it makes the invitation an inspectable demonstration whose claims are exposed to shared sight and reflection.

activation_trace.role: The speech-call supplies the invitation whose content is developed into publicly inspectable evidence.
Plain visible manifestation literally supplies exposure to sight and makes demonstration the focus mode.
Uncovering meaning by speech or sign supplies the warning's epistemic clarity.
Seeing by eye and insight converts reception from mere hearing into examination.
Light and illumination supply a visible field in which the public claim can be contemplated.
A shining lamp supplies a concentrated public sign within the later visual argument.

structural_cues: 71:13-20 shifts from delivery report to rhetorical questioning and visible cosmological, vegetal, and terrestrial evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear explanation, an invitation to see, and luminous signs; I infer that the later demonstration unfolds what the focus call makes public. A live alternative is that the visual argument is independent content and جِهَارًا still denotes delivery alone.

changed_reading.before: The call is publicly audible speech.
changed_reading.after: The call is a publicly inspectable appeal whose claims are unfolded through shared visible evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant د ع ع mapping rather than the ordinary د ع و branch; it remains anchored to the focus word and is activated by literal flight and later disobedience. Downstream prose should present it only as a pressure or herding analogy, never as a replacement gloss for دَعَوْتُهُمْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet explicitly maps the focus root at word 3 to non-dominant root_000477 as well as dominant root_000478.

activation_trace.role: Rough thrusting and forceful driving supply an exploratory pressure vector inside the repeated call.
A herding or chiding cry supplies the specific image of publicly driving a resistant collective.
Literal fleeing supplies the opposed motion that makes a driving image mechanically coherent.
Departure from obedience supplies the later resistance that keeps the pressure reading live.

changed_reading.before: The public call gently invites a stationary audience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repeated public calling also exerts chiding pressure on a collective already moving away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a sun-dazzled eye is a peripheral perceptual branch of ج ه ر, not the normal adverbial sense; it remains anchored to جِهَارًا and gains a visible analogue from the later sun and light. Downstream prose should qualify it as a phenomenology of excessive exposure, not claim that the verse says the audience was literally dazzled.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جِهَارًا at word 4 has a packet branch in which strong sunlight overcomes the eye.

activation_trace.role: The sun-dazzled eye literally supplies a limit case where increased visibility impairs reception.
Light and illumination supply the later positive visibility field against which overexposure can be imagined.
The sun and its brightness provide the exact contextual analogue for the focus branch's dazzled eye.

changed_reading.before: Greater publicity necessarily produces clearer reception.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call's exposure may become dazzling: manifestation increases while the audience's capacity to receive it decreases.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequence revises جِهَارًا from mere loudness into a public-exposure tactic after flight and self-covering.
The next verse places the open call inside deliberate public/private channel coverage.
Later social and visual sequences recast the call as a public counter-claim of allegiance and an inspectable demonstration.
Material flow branches preserve an exploratory model in which invitation primes and clears a channel for continuing response and abundance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories separate audibility, visibility, assembly, well-clearing, and dazzling exposure within ج ه ر, while the split د ع و mapping preserves both attraction and forceful driving. That range allowed several coexisting mechanisms without collapsing publicness into volume alone.
remaining_uncertainties: ثُمَّ may mark causal tactical escalation or only narrated sequence.
The primer and hydraulic alignment may be productive material analogy or may over-connect later promised benefits to the act of calling.
The allegiance contest may characterize جِهَارًا itself or only explain the later failure of the public call.
The dazzling and forceful-driving outliers depend on branch-distant mappings and must remain explicitly exploratory.
